reviewer: Claude source, predicate and witness review
scope: robocasa NavigateKitchen at the pinned revision; seed 0 witness only. Semantic projection of the official predicate, not physical qualification of other seeds or scenes.
task_language: Navigate to the stand mixer. (Target fixture sampled per seed.)

predicate_and_helpers.basis: Read _check_success (mobilebase0_base body position and euler yaw against target_pos/target_ori) and compute_robot_base_placement_pose.

reset_and_randomization.basis: Read _setup_kitchen_references: source and target fixtures sampled per seed among unique fixture classes at least 1 m apart; the robot starts at the source fixture.

assets_and_frames.basis: Target pose is in world frame in front of the nearest counter of the fixture; the base yaw is the body's world euler z.

success_timing.basis: Evaluated after every control step; the ORA session latches the first success.

public_observability.basis: Fixtures are visible from the base-mounted cameras; the base pose is public proprioception (mobile_base).

success_witness.basis: Witness: the real move_base servo driven to the target pose on seed 0 gives true (episode latched).

counterexamples.basis: Witness: behind the spot and turned 25 degrees give false; reset state false.

no_expert_strategy.basis: Clauses state end conditions only; no approach, grasp, route or motion advice.

privacy.basis: No coordinates, thresholds, fixture or object identifiers, joint values or predicate names enter the public text; numeric limits stay in this private record.

conditions.source_basis: _check_success: base body xy within 0.20 m of target_pos from compute_robot_base_placement_pose (the standard working spot in front of the fixture).
conditions.interpretation: Stop at the spot directly in front of the fixture.

conditions.source_basis: _check_success: cos(target yaw - base yaw) >= 0.98 (within about 11 degrees of facing the fixture).

conditions.interpretation: The 0.20 m radius, the yaw bound and the target pose itself are withheld.
conditions.omission_reason: Numeric limits and the private target pose stay off-policy; arm pose is irrelevant to the predicate.

public_clauses: Drive the mobile base to stop directly in front of the named fixture, close to it, with the robot squarely facing it; stopping beside it, further back or turned away does not complete the task.

counterexamples.case: Base 0.35 m behind the target spot, facing the fixture: false.
Base at the target spot turned 25 degrees: false.

limitations: Witness covers seed 0 only and uses direct state edits or scripted moves, never a policy rollout; source-derived negative cases marked as such were not executed.
